note: An independent reproduction of Sahl's stars' apparent places and of three stars' crossings, not computed by this app: the Hipparcos new reduction (I/311) with XHIP radial velocities, DE441 Earth vectors, under IAU 2006 precession-nutation and under Vondrák et al. 2011 long-term precession with that model's own mean obliquity. 'pairs': each star's Swiss Ephemeris key and Hipparcos number. 'places': apparent right ascension, declination, ecliptic longitude and latitude of date, in degrees, at a Julian Day in UT1. 'events': the star's centre at altitude 0 and its meridian transits, geocentric, without refraction or diurnal aberration, as a Julian Day in UT1, at the latitude and east longitude given.
